title: Ziyarat of Lady Khadija
urduTitle: زیارت حضرت خدیجہ سلام اللہ علیہا
intro: The visitation of Lady Khadija bint Khuwaylid, wife of Prophet Muhammad and mother of Lady Fatima.
description: Read Ziyarat of Lady Khadija with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا اُمَّ الْاَئِمَّةِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا اُمَّ المُؤْمِنِيْنَ
blocks.transliteration: Assalaamo A’Layke Yaa Ummal A-Immatit Taahereena - Assalaamo A’Layke Yaa Ummal Momineena
blocks.english: Peace on you, O the mother of the pure Imams, Peace be on you, O the mother of the believing men
Peace be on you, O the first of the believing women
Peace be on you, O the sincere lady among the devoted ones

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا سَيِّدَةَ الْحَرَمِ وَ مَلِكَةَ الْبَطْحَاءِ
blocks.transliteration: Assalaamo A’Layke Yaa Sayyedatal Harame Wa Malekatal Bathaa-E
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O the chief lady of the sacrosanct (haram) And the queen of Mecca

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَم عَلَيْكِ يَا اَوَّلَ مَنْ صَدَّقَتْ ِرَسُوْلِ اللهِ مِنَ النِّسَآءِ
blocks.transliteration: Assalaamo A’Layke Yaa Awwala Man Saddaqat Be Rasoolillaahe Menan Nesaaa-E
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O the first one to believe in the Apostle of Allah from among the women

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَنْ وَفَتْ بِالْعُبُوْدِيَّةِ حَقَّ الْوَفَاءِ وَ اَسْلَمَتْ نَفْسَهَا وَ اَنْفَقَتْ مَالَهَا لِسَيِّدِ الْاَنْبِيَآءِ
blocks.transliteration: Assalaamo A’Layke Yaa Man Wafat Bil O’Boodiyyate Haqqal Wafaa-E Wa Aslamat Nafsahaa Wa Anfaqat Maalahaa Le Sayyedil Anbeyaaa-E
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O the one who observed servitude as it ought to be observed, submitted herself and discharged her wealth in the service of the chief of the Prophets.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا قَرِيْنَةَ حَبِيْبِ اِلٰهِ السَّمَآءِ الْمُزَّوَّجَةِ بِخُلاَصَةِ الْاَصْفِيَآءِ يَابْنَةَ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ الْخَلِيْلِ
blocks.transliteration: Assalaamo A’Layke Yaa Qareenata Habeebe Elaahis Samaaail Mozawwajate Be Kholaasatil Asfeyaaa-E Yabnata Ibraahemal Khaleele
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O the companion of the beloved of the Lord of the Heaven. The spouse of the epitome of the chosen ones. O the daughter of Ibraheem, the friend (of Allah)

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَنْ سَلَّمَ عَلَيْهَا جَبْرَئِيْلُ وَ بَلَّغَ اِلَيْهَا
blocks.transliteration: Assalaamo A’Layke Yaa Man Sallama A’Layhaa Jibraeelo Wa Ballagha Elayhas
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O the one to whom Jibraeel used to salute and used to convey to her
the salutations from Allah, the Majestic.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا حَافِظَةَ دِيْنِ اللهِ
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O the protector of the religion of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا نَاصِرَةَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O the helper of the Apostle of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَنْ تَوَلىَّ دَفْنَهَا رَسُوْلُ اللهِ
blocks.transliteration: Assalaamo A’Layke Yaa Man Tawallaa Dafnahaa Rasoolilaahe
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O the one whose burial was arranged by the Apostle of Allah
and he entrusted her to the Mercy of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكِ حَبِيْبَةُ اللهِ وَ خِيَرَةَ اُمَّتِهِ وَ اَنَّ اللهَ
blocks.transliteration: Ash-Hado Annake Habeebullaahe Wa Kheyarata Ummatehi Wa Annallaaha
blocks.english: I bear witness that you are esteemed near Allah

blocks.arabic: جَعَلَكِ فِىْ مُسْتَقَرِّ رَحْمَتِهِ فِىْ قَصْرٍ مِّنَ الْيَاقُوْتِ
blocks.english: and the chosen one among His nation and that Allah has placed you in His Mercy

blocks.arabic: وَ الْعِقْيَانِ فِىْ اَعْلٰى مَنَازِلِ الْجِنَانِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْكِ وَ رَحْمَةُ الله وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ
blocks.transliteration: Fee Qasrin Menal Yaaqoote Wal E’Qyaane Fee A-A’Laa Manaazelil Jenaane, Sallallaaho A’Layke Wa Rahmatullaahe Wa Barakaatohu
blocks.english: in a place built of ruby and in the highest grades of Paradise, May Allah send salutations upon you and His Mercy and Blessings .

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت حضرت خدیجہ سلام اللہ علیہا کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
